content: Isirelibɑn yorun wɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ tiɑsen surun tɔ̃ɔ ɡbiikiru sɔɔrɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u kɑ Esekiɛli ɡɑri kuɑ. U nɛɛ,
tɔnun bii, wee Tiriɡibu bɑ Yerusɑlɛmu yɛ̃ɛmɔ bɑ mɔ̀, wee yɑ kɑm kuɑ yèn mi ɡiɑ tɔmbu bɑ rɑ rɑɑ kpe bɑ̀ n ɡɑm dɔɔ. Tɛ̃ ben mi ɡiɑ tɔmbɑ koo wurɑ kpɑ be, bu ɡobi ko. Domi Yerusɑlɛmu yɑ kuɑ bɑnsu.
Yen sɔ̃ tɛ̃, Yinni Gusunɔ u koo Tiri ye mɔru seesi u de bwese dɑbinu nu ye wɔri nu tɛriɑ nɡe mɛ dɑɑrɑ rɑ nim yibu.
Kpɑ nu yen ɡbɑ̃rɑnu kɔsuku kɑ yen tɑbu durɔbun kuku yenu. Nu koo ye kpuro kɛrɑwɑ mɑm mɑm kpɑ Tiri ye, yɑ n sɑ̃ɑ nɡe kpee sɑɑrɑ.
Yɑ koo kowɑ nɡe tem bureru te tɑ wɑ̃ɑ nim wɔ̃ku sɔɔ mi surɔkɔbɑ bɑ rɑ ben yɑ̃ɑkoronu kewe. Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u yeni ɡeruɑ. Bwese tukunu nu koo nɑ nu wuu ɡe wɔri.
Kpɑ nu be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡen turuku ɡo ɡo. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, bɑ koo ɡiɑ mɑ wiyɑ u sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ.

Wee ye Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ ɡeruɑ. U nɛɛ, u koo de Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko wi u sinɑmbu kpuro dɑm kere u nɑ sɑɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑn di u Tiri ye wɔri. U koo nɑ kɑ dumi kɑ tɑbu kɛkɛ be dumi ɡɑwe kɑ sere mɑɑsɔbu kɑ tɑbu kowo dɑbi dɑbinu.
U koo Tirin bɑru kpɑɑnu kpuro kpeerɑsiɑ. Tɑbu kowobu bɑ koo kuku yenu ɡbe kpɑ bu tɑbu sĩɑ kpĩ bɑ n tɛrɛnu nɛni bu kɑ tii ɡɑnɛ.
Bɑ koo Tiri yen ɡbɑ̃rɑnu kɔsuku bu suriri kɑ ben tɑbu yɑ̃nu.
Kpɑ ben dumi dɑbi dɑbi ten tuɑ yu ye wukiri kpɑ yen ɡɑni yi n diirimɔ mɑɑsɔbun wɔkinun sɔ̃ kɑ tɑbu kɛkɛ ben wɔkinun sɔ̃. Domi bɑ koo Tiri ye wɔriwɑ nɡe wuu ɡe bɑ kɑmiɑ kɔ.
Bɑ koo kɑ dumi swɛɛ kpuro swĩiwɑ kpɑ bɑ n tɔmbu ɡoomɔ kɑ tɑkobi kpɑ bu yen bũu sɑ̃ɑ yenun ɡberebɑ suriri bèn sɔ̃ yɑ woo kɑnɑmɔ.
Bɑ koo yen dukiɑ kɑ yen kiɑ ni yɑ dɔrɑmɔ ɡurɑwɑ nɡe ye bɑ tɑbu diimɑ kpɑ bu yen ɡbɑ̃rɑnu kɑ yen dii ɡeenu kɔsuku bu suriri kpɑ bu yen kpenu kɑ yen dɑ̃ɑ kɑ yen kɛ̃ki ɡurɑ bu sure nim wɔ̃ku sɔɔ.
U koo de ben womusu su nɔru ko. Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ mɔrɔkunun swĩi nɔɔmɔ mi.
U koo de yu kowɑ nɡe kpee sɑɑrɑ yèn wɔllɔ surɔkɔbɑ bɑ ko n dɑ ben yɑ̃ɑkoronu kewe. Bɑ ǹ yen bɑnsu seeyɑmɔ. Wi, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u yeni ɡeruɑ.
Wee ye Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡerumɔ Tiri yen sɔ̃. U nɛɛ, be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ n tomɑ nim wɔ̃kun ɡoorɔ, bɑ̀ n nuɑ Tiri yɑ bɑnsu kuɑ mɑ bɑ be bɑ mɛɛrɑ wɑn weeweenu nɔɔmɔ, bɑ koo diiri.

Wee tem mɛn kpɑro be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ nim wɔ̃kun berɑ ɡiɑ kpuro bɑ koo se ben sinɑ kitɑnun di bu ben yɑbe bɑkɑnu kɑ ben yɑbe ni bɑ sɔmɑ doke potiri bɑ n wurure bɑ n sɔ̃ temɔ. Sɑɑ kpuro sɔɔ, bɑ ko n bɛrum soorewɑ kpɑ bɑ n nuki sɑnkire Tirin sɔ̃.
Bɑ ko n ɡɔɔ wuri mɔ̀ Tirin sɔ̃ bɑ n mɔ̀,

content.text: wee yɑ kɑm kuɑ ye, ye yɑ rɑɑ yĩsiru yɑrɑ mi.
Ye, yèn tɔmbu bɑ rɑɑ dɑbiru bo nim wɔ̃kun berɑ mi ɡiɑ.
Beyɑ bɑ rɑɑ mɑɑ dɑm bo,
mɑ be bɑ kɑ bu sikerenɛ bɑ bu nɑsie.
Wee be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ tem burenɔ
bɑ diirimɔ Tiri yen kɑm kobun sɔ̃.
Be bɑ tomɑ bɑ kɑ wɑ̃ɑ nim wɔ̃kun ɡoorɔ

content: Wee ye Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ ɡeruɑ. U nɛɛ, u koo de Tiri yu ko bɑnsu kpɑ ɡoo u kun mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi. Sɑnɑm mɛyɑ u koo de nim wɔ̃kun nim mu ye wukiri kpɑ ye kpuro yu num yɑ n wɑ̃ɑ ɡɔribun wɑ̃ɑ yerɔ mi yeruku tɔmbɑ kpĩ.
U koo de yu dɑ sere tem sɔɔwɔ mi yeruku tɔmbɑ wɑ̃ɑ kpɑ yɑ n kɔ̃ɔre mi. U koo de yɑ n wɑ̃ɑ mi kɑ ɡɔribu. Goo kun mɑɑ sinɑmɔ ye sɔɔ. Yɑ ǹ mɑɑ ɑyeru wɑsi wɑsobun suunu sɔɔ.
Tɔmbɑ koo nɑndɑ ye yɑ koo ye deemɑn sɔ̃. Yɑ ǹ ko yɑ n mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu. Domi bɑ koo ye kɔsukuwɑ mɑm mɑm kpɑ bu ye kɑsu bu biɑ. Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u yeni ɡeruɑ.
Wuri yi bɑ kuɑ Tirin bɑnsun sɔ̃
